purpose: The twenty node-firing acceptance requirements of the full-brain guide, as a machine-readable list. Every entry starts NOT_TESTED. They supplement the full_required set in fleet.json; they do not replace it, and a PASS here is not full_brain_connected.
how_to_record: A worker that runs a test copies this entry into its own receipt under node_firing_tests with status, the invocation it was observed in (interactive or scheduled, account, slot, run), the engine and data revision tested, the exact command and its output reference, and the evidence artifact paths. Fixtures are engineering tests and are labelled as such; a result on the authentic approved graph says so. Do not edit this file to record a result.

engines.math: the typed claim graph of the math_brain package (retrieval.py, _graph_spread)
engines.cognitive: the memory engine (brain.py, spread_recall.py and their sidecars)

tests.title: Genuine seed selection
tests.required_observation: Actual production input produces identified seeds and scores with source and configuration hashes.

tests.title: Real edge propagation
tests.required_observation: A non-seed result is connected by an actual recorded edge or path; seed retention alone cannot pass.

tests.title: Bounded multi-hop behavior
tests.required_observation: A controlled chain exercises the supported path depth; removing a necessary edge changes the actual output.

tests.title: Correct typed direction
tests.required_observation: Proof-dependency traversal does not turn arbitrary similarity or reversed relationships into proof support.

tests.title: Negative evidence
tests.required_observation: A counterexample or refutation relation surfaces a warning, not positive evidence of truth.

tests.title: Engine-specific weighting
tests.required_observation: Decay, fan-out rules and seed aggregation match the particular engine, not a blended substitute.

tests.title: Cycles and malformed edges
tests.required_observation: No runaway traversal; missing references and malformed data have documented safe outcomes.

tests.title: Salience and margin gates
tests.required_observation: Suitable controlled cases pass or fail the real surfacing thresholds; no forced firing by lowering production thresholds.

tests.title: Non-obviousness and redundancy
tests.required_observation: Cognitive surfacing distinguishes associative results from already-obvious lexical hits.

tests.title: Deduplication and state
tests.required_observation: Repeated requests and distinct session or run identities exercise the intended suppression and reset or persistence rules.

tests.title: Mistake and reflex path
tests.required_observation: A stored scoped failure triggers the relevant warning; an unrelated input is a negative control.

tests.title: Real semantic channel
tests.required_observation: Compatible authentic vectors or encoder, or the documented sidecar method, execute; fallback-only operation is clearly marked.

tests.title: Supersession
tests.required_observation: Current corrections replace eligible historical endpoints as implemented, without deleting source history.

tests.title: Node attachments
tests.required_observation: Parent plus required multipart documents are read fully and verified; corruption raises a visible integrity error.

tests.title: Strong-node gate
tests.required_observation: Observe-only, disabled, invalid generation and genuinely authorized active modes are distinguished.

tests.title: Actual context delivery
tests.required_observation: Fired or retrieved content is supplied to the working agent before the relevant reasoning step, with no claimed hidden neuron access.

tests.title: Cross-run restoration
tests.required_observation: A later scheduled invocation loads the same real checkpoint and relevant persistent firing or learning state by hash.

tests.title: Cross-account handoff
tests.required_observation: Another enrolled account reads and consumes the exact permitted artifact using its own authorized connection.

tests.title: Complete eligible graph
tests.required_observation: Manifest-complete permitted nodes, edges and sidecars are loaded; deliberate samples are identified separately.

tests.title: Legitimate silence versus failure
tests.required_observation: A no-fire decision with evaluated gates is distinguishable from missing data, disabled components or exceptions.
